target: local Apple M4 (G16G), 10 GPU cores, macOS 26.6.2 (25G82)
boundary: public Metal API only; runtime MSL compile of our own carrier/census kernels; binary-archive splice of our own hand-assembled AGX programs (tools/agx-isa isadb.assemble()); owned shared buffers; every case a fresh process; no Apple binary, archive, BO, or command-stream inspection beyond our own compiled/assembled bytes
hypothesis_origin: This experiment's own pilot-phase OWN-SHADER differential census (analysis/census.py, PROGRESS.md Milestones 2-5) against docs/isa/register-move-and-liveness.md sections 2.6/2.7 and EXP-0099's RESULTS.md H4/H5 (the two named DRV-ISA-01 synthesis blockers). No third-party document is a hypothesis source for this experiment.

raw_schema.00_env.json: environment/provenance receipt (informational git_revision NEVER gated on -- pinned_revision above + authored_*_sha256 are what matters)
raw_schema.01_results.jsonl: GATED, byte-compared-across-runs: one JSON object per case with keys i,name,group,oracle,expect_match,notes,status,pipeline_source,out_hex,observed,match -- no nondeterministic field
raw_schema.01_timing.jsonl: NON-GATED sibling: one JSON object per case with keys i,duration_ms,argv,stdout,stderr -- explicitly NOT required to match across runs
raw_schema.02_dispatch.json: run summary: n_cases, status_counts, match_counts, results_sha256, code hashes
raw_schema.STOP.json: written on any pre-capture or capture-time stop; raw/ left absent if pre-capture

hypothesis_to_group_map.H1_load_extmode_fix: LOAD_FIX (positive: extmode relocatable across reg7/reg3/reg16/reg20, with dst_lo/dst_ext9 held at the known-good token; falu2i's mods=0xC0 requirement)
hypothesis_to_group_map.H1_load_mechanism_falsification: LOAD_REPLICATE (reproduces EXP-0099's own failure under the OLD field model) + LOAD_ADVERSARIAL (falsifies 3 plausible wrong repairs + 1 pilot-phase over-theory)
hypothesis_to_group_map.H2_move_uniform_not_gpr: MOVE_UNIFORM (producer-value independence, producer-family independence, register-pair quantization, src_flag=1 positive control, EXP-0087's byte+2=0x21 open-question retest, silent-zero boundary extension)

confirm_vs_refute.H1: CONFIRMED if all 4 LOAD_FIX cases match V_LOAD and all 5 LOAD_ADVERSARIAL negative cases (all but control_dst_nibble_independent_of_srcA) mismatch and the falu2i mods pair behaves as predicted; REFUTED for any specific claim whose case disagrees with its prediction (see PRE_REGISTRATION.md section 3 table for the per-case breakdown -- this is a MULTI-PART claim, not a single pass/fail).
confirm_vs_refute.H2: CONFIRMED (mechanism characterization, NOT a fix) if move_replicate_baseline and move_producer_independence_altvalue read the IDENTICAL bit pattern, move_loadsourced_independence reads that SAME pattern, the two register pairs are internally consistent but mutually different, and the src_flag=1 positive controls read the literal integers 1/2/3; REFUTED (in the sense of 'the fixed-slot model is wrong') if the producer-independence cases actually track the producer's value/family, which would mean this IS somehow a real (if currently misdirected) GPR read.

oracle_source: casematrix.py build_cases() -- pure Python, computed independently of any GPU run, using isadb.imm_encode/imm_decode for the minifloat immediate domain, literal MEM_WORDS values, and struct.pack/unpack bit-pattern reinterpretation for the H2 constants (established during this experiment's own pilot phase per PROGRESS.md, before this matrix was frozen)
clean_room: OWN-SHADER + HW-PROBE. Every byte executed is either our own hand-assembled instruction sequence (tools/agx-isa isadb.assemble()) or the compiled form of our own kernels/*.metal (tools/shdump, runtime MSL compile via the public Metal API). No third-party document, leaked material, or Apple binary introspection anywhere in this experiment.
